verdict.rationale: Lovable is an AI app-building platform, so outbound webhooks for platform events (deploys, project changes) are a fair question, but nothing in the evidence documents a webhook or event-subscription feature. The only programmatic surfaces shown are the Lovable MCP server, Build with URL, and the Slack and Telegram bots. Edge functions in the generated apps' backend are not a way to subscribe to Lovable's own events, and the OpenAPI probe found no API spec.
